text: The Nominating Panel – Toronto Local Appeal Body will conduct interviews and recommend five candidates, including one as Chair, to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body.

City Council on November 25 and 26, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Toronto Local Appeal Body, including one as Chair, for a term of office starting on December 14, 2020 and ending on December 14, 2024 and until successors are appointed: Sabnavis Gopikrishna Christine Kilby Dino Lombardi, Chair Stanley Makuch Ted Yao 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (October 23, 2020) from the Interim City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body. Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (October 23, 2020) from the Interim City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as they relate to personal matters…
